Project Title: Space Mission Design Game

Space Mission Design Game is an interactive educational website developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It allows users to experience the exciting process of planning and designing a space mission through a fun, game-like environment. Players can choose their mission objectives, select spacecraft components, manage their available resources, explore planets, and complete different space challenges.

The project combines space science, creativity, problem-solving, and basic mission-planning concepts to make learning more engaging. It addresses the challenge by transforming complex space exploration ideas into an interactive experience that students and beginners can easily understand and enjoy.

This project is important because it encourages curiosity about space, develops critical-thinking and decision-making skills, and inspires young learners to explore science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). Our goal is to make space exploration educational, accessible, and enjoyable for everyone.

Detailed Project Description – Interactive Space Mission Design Game

Our project, Interactive Space Mission Design Game, is an educational space exploration game created for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It allows players to experience how real space missions are planned, designed and carried out.

How does it work?
Players begin by choosing their destination: the Moon, Mars, an asteroid or Earth orbit. They then select a mission objective, such as exploration, photography or scientific research. Next, they design their spacecraft by choosing its weight category and selecting equipment and instruments while balancing weight, power and budget.

Once the spacecraft is ready, players launch their mission. During the journey, they must navigate through space, avoid incoming meteors and collect fuel. They also monitor important factors such as fuel, lives, score and distance. The final challenge involves safely landing the spacecraft within the designated lunar landing zone.

Benefits and Intended Impact
The game makes space science easier and more enjoyable to understand. It develops decision-making, logical thinking, creativity and problem-solving skills. It also introduces players to real-world concepts such as spacecraft design, resource management and scientific instruments.

Our intended impact is to inspire students and young learners to become curious about space exploration and develop an interest in STEM education.

Tools and Technologies
- HTML: Website structure.
- CSS: Visual design, styling and layout.
- JavaScript: Interactive gameplay, controls and game mechanics.
- GitHub:Code storage and project sharing.
- Web Browser:Running and testing the game.
- Prezi:Presenting and explaining the project.

Creativity and Innovation
The creative part of our project is that it combines spacecraft engineering with an interactive arcade-style game. Instead of simply reading about space missions, players become mission designers and pilots. Every decision, from selecting spacecraft equipment to managing fuel during flight, affects their mission experience.

Factors Considered
We considered educational value, user-friendliness, gameplay experience, realistic mission-planning concepts, resource limitations and accessibility. Our goal was to create something that is both entertaining and educational, allowing beginners to explore the challenges of space missions in an engaging way.
